# Fastly Edge
> Fastly Edge provides edge cloud infrastructure, CDN, security, compute, and observability documentation for developers and operators.

This site centers on Fastly’s technical documentation, product guides, API references, and operational resources for building, securing, and running applications at the edge.

## Getting Started
- [Documentation Home](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/): Main entry point for Fastly product, platform, and developer documentation.
- [Getting Started](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/getting-started/): Introductory guides for setting up and using Fastly services.
- [Developer Hub](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/): Browse product guides, tutorials, and implementation documentation.
- [Support and Help](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/getting-started/services/support/): Learn how to access support resources and service assistance.
- [Fastly API Overview](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/reference/api/): Overview of Fastly API families and reference materials.

## Compute
- [Compute Documentation](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/compute/): Guides for building, deploying, and operating Compute applications.
- [Compute Quickstart](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/compute/getting-started/): Start building and deploying your first Compute service.
- [JavaScript on Compute](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/compute/javascript/): Documentation for developing Compute applications with JavaScript.
- [Rust on Compute](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/compute/rust/): Documentation for developing Compute applications with Rust.
- [Compute Concepts](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/compute/concepts/): Core concepts, architecture, and runtime behavior for Compute.
- [Compute API Reference](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/reference/api/compute/): API reference for managing Compute-related resources.

## Delivery and CDN
- [Delivery Documentation](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/full-site-delivery/): Guides for configuring CDN delivery and site acceleration.
- [Create and Configure Services](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/full-site-delivery/getting-started/): Set up delivery services and basic Fastly configuration.
- [Caching](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/full-site-delivery/caching/): Learn caching behavior, cache control, and optimization techniques.
- [Origins](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/full-site-delivery/origins/): Configure origins, shielding, health checks, and backend behavior.
- [Image Optimization](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/full-site-delivery/image-optimization/): Transform and optimize images at the edge.
- [Streaming and Media](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/full-site-delivery/video/): Documentation for video, streaming, and media delivery workflows.

## VCL
- [VCL Documentation](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/vcl/): Guides for customizing Fastly services with Varnish Configuration Language.
- [VCL Snippets](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/vcl/using-and-creating-vcl-snippets/): Create and manage reusable VCL snippets.
- [Custom VCL](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/vcl/custom-vcl/): Work with custom VCL services and advanced configuration.
- [VCL Best Practices](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/vcl/best-practices/): Recommended patterns for maintainable and effective VCL logic.
- [VCL Reference](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/reference/vcl/): Reference for Fastly-supported VCL variables, functions, and statements.
- [Conditions and Headers](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/vcl/conditions/): Configure request conditions, headers, and edge logic.

## Security
- [Security Documentation](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/security/): Guides for securing applications and traffic on Fastly.
- [Next-Gen WAF](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/next-gen-waf/): Documentation for deploying and managing Fastly Next-Gen WAF.
- [DDoS Protection](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/security/ddos-protection/): Learn about Fastly’s DDoS mitigation and protection capabilities.
- [TLS and Certificates](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/full-site-delivery/domains-and-origins/tls/): Configure TLS, certificates, and secure domain delivery.
- [Access Control Lists](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/full-site-delivery/fastly-security/access-control-lists/): Manage ACLs for request filtering and access control.
- [Bot Management](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/security/bot-management/): Documentation for identifying and managing automated traffic.

## Observability and Logging
- [Observability Documentation](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/observability/): Guides for monitoring, metrics, and operational visibility.
- [Real-Time Analytics](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/observability/real-time-analytics/): Use Fastly analytics to monitor traffic and performance.
- [Logging Endpoints](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/integrations/logging-endpoints/): Configure streaming logs to external destinations.
- [Metrics and Monitoring](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/observability/metrics/): Understand available metrics and monitoring approaches.
- [Alerts](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/observability/alerts/): Set up alerting for traffic, service, and operational events.
- [Historical Stats API](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/reference/api/stats/): API reference for retrieving service statistics and usage data.

## APIs and CLI
- [API Reference Home](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/reference/api/): Central reference for Fastly REST APIs.
- [Fastly API](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/reference/api/services/): Reference for services, versions, domains, backends, and configuration.
- [TLS API](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/reference/api/tls/): API reference for certificates, domains, and TLS subscriptions.
- [Compute API](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/reference/api/compute/): Manage Compute packages, deployments, and related resources.
- [CLI Documentation](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/reference/cli/): Reference for the Fastly command-line interface.
- [Terraform Provider](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/integrations/non-fastly-services/developer-guide-terraform/): Manage Fastly resources using Terraform workflows.

## SDKs and Integrations
- [Integrations Overview](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/integrations/): Browse integrations with logging, monitoring, and developer tools.
- [Logging Integrations](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/integrations/logging-endpoints/): Send Fastly logs to cloud, SIEM, and analytics platforms.
- [Fastly Fiddle](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/tools/fiddle/): Test and share VCL logic in an interactive browser environment.
- [Developer Tools](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/tools/): Documentation for Fastly tooling and developer workflows.
- [Language SDKs](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/reference/api/): Use Fastly APIs with generated or community client libraries.
- [Third-Party Services](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/integrations/non-fastly-services/): Connect Fastly with external infrastructure and SaaS platforms.

## Account and Platform Administration
- [Account Management](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/account-info/): Manage users, roles, billing, and account-level settings.
- [User Management](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/account-info/managing-user-accounts/): Add, remove, and administer user access.
- [Role-Based Access Control](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/account-info/managing-user-accounts/using-roles/): Configure roles and permissions for teams and services.
- [Service Management](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/getting-started/services/working-with-services/): Organize and manage Fastly services in your account.
- [Billing and Usage](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/account-info/billing/): Understand invoices, billing details, and usage reporting.
- [Single Sign-On](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/account-info/security/enabling-sso/): Configure SSO for centralized authentication.

## Reference and Resources
- [Reference Home](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/reference/): Browse API, CLI, and technical reference materials.
- [HTTP Headers Reference](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/reference/http/http-headers/): Reference for Fastly-specific and relevant HTTP headers.
- [Status Page](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/concepts/status/): Learn where to check platform and service status information.
- [Changelog](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/changelog/): Track documentation and product-related updates.
- [Glossary](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/guides/concepts/definitions/): Definitions for Fastly platform and edge networking terminology.
- [Code Examples](https://www.fastly-edge.com/documentation/solutions/examples/): Example implementations and solution patterns for common use cases.
